fact: On 28 August 2025 the FDSUT secretary general said 900 billion FCFA of the New Deal Technologique's envelope of over 1,000 billion, to be raised through public-private partnership, had been gathered and 150 billion remained to be mobilised.
title: New Deal technologique : l'Etat « travaille activement » à mobiliser un reliquat de 150 milliards
